reviews.author: Farnaz F
reviews.quote: I had the best experience working with Farzad for my mortgage. From start to finish, he was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and responsive.

reviews.author: Saba C.
reviews.quote: We felt confident every step of the way knowing he had our best interests in mind.

reviews.author: Ali T
reviews.quote: From day one, Farzad and his amazing team, especially Parisa, went above and beyond to make it happen.

reviews.author: Haniyeh Ghafoori
reviews.quote: Thank you for guiding me through every step and helping make this possible. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mehrara Ayaz
reviews.quote: Farzad Behzadi was amazing to work with! Professional, supportive, and very helpful throughout our mortgage process. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Hamid Alinia
reviews.quote: As a first-time homebuyer, I had many questions and wanted to make sure I was making the right decisions. From the initial pre-approval to the final mortgage approval, Farzad made the entire process smooth, straightforward, and stress-free.

reviews.author: Behrang Shahryari
reviews.quote: About a year ago, when I first wanted to get a mortgage, he very clearly and honestly explained that it wasn’t possible yet and guided me on the steps I needed to take to get there.

reviews.author: Maryam Toudeh Kharman
reviews.quote: Thanks to his expertise, I was able to secure approval by a bank. I highly recommend him, especially for complex cases.

reviews.author: Farshid Saadvandi
reviews.quote: He was incredibly caring, patient, professional, and always worked hard to find solutions, especially during the most stressful moments of our home-buying process.

reviews.author: Faye Kh
reviews.quote: What stood out to us was how organized and proactive he was because he gathered every required document right from the beginning which made the process move smoothly without the usual last-minute requests or delays.

reviews.author: shora hosseinzadeh
reviews.quote: While he often makes things work, he’s also refreshingly honest—no false promises, just a pragmatic, realistic approach.

reviews.author: Sally Karimi
reviews.quote: I was a first-time home buyer and also new to Canada. I literally had zero information about the whole process and he made it like a piece of cake for me.

reviews.author: Ehsan
reviews.quote: I had a unique case, and it wasn’t easy to get the amount I needed, but Farzad worked very hard with multiple banks and brokers to secure the right loan for me.

reviews.author: Ali Tahsili
reviews.quote: He secured a very competitive rate for me and also took the time to consult me on how I could further improve my mortgage rate based on my profile.

reviews.author: Mona
reviews.quote: As first-time home buyers, the process felt overwhelming at times, but Farzad’s patience, professionalism, and clear communication made everything so much easier.

reviews.author: Behrooz Jam
reviews.quote: He and his team were always easy to reach and quick to respond, making the whole process smooth and stress-free.

reviews.author: Amir Zhaleh
reviews.quote: Communication was prompt and transparent—no surprises, no stress. It truly felt like he was working with us, not just for us.

reviews.author: Zahra Tahsili
reviews.quote: His efforts significantly minimized my stress, which was especially important given that this was my first time buying a home in Canada.

reviews.author: Majid Taherinejad
reviews.quote: As a very picky client, I had numerous questions and concerns throughout the process. Farzad answered every question with patience and clarity, demonstrating a deep knowledge of the mortgage industry.

reviews.author: Kyle Henderson
reviews.quote: He was extremely knowledgeable and fast acting to secure us a favourable rate in a volatile market. Thanks to Farzad, my wife and I have a new place to call home.

reviews.author: Mohammad Vatanchirad
reviews.quote: I never felt rushed or uninformed, and he provided regular updates on the progress of my application.

reviews.author: Dena Ghotbi
reviews.quote: He never left my questions without answer even when I reached out to him during the weekend or after working hours.

reviews.author: Peyman Sindareh
reviews.quote: I've worked with Farzad Behzadi on multiple transactions, and each experience has been exceptional.
